$comment: W3C Time Ontology (OWL-Time) alignment: https://www.w3.org/TR/owl-time/ — namespace prefix time: = http://www.w3.org/2006/time#. Each present step is a proposed time:ProperInterval on the video's media timeline; every time:Instant is a number of seconds from the video's first frame, as in a run record whose runtime.clockMode is media.
title: Rhylthyme Video Suggestions Schema
description: Step times in one video proposed by a model or a baseline (a proposer) for a person to confirm: one document per proposer run over one video and one program version. Suggestions are never shown on a public page. Confirmed times become a run record with runtime.clockMode media and endedBy observer.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the video suggestions schema this document conforms to

programVersion.description: Content hash of the program whose steps are suggested, as in a run record's programVersion: 'sha256:' followed by the hex SHA-256 of the canonical JSON (keys sorted by code point, no whitespace, UTF-8, integral numbers written without a fractional part)

video.description: The video the times refer to

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the video file's bytes. No 'sha256:' prefix: the key names the algorithm

durationSeconds.description: Length of the video's media timeline in seconds

name.description: Name of the proposer, e.g. timer-reanchored

settings.description: Settings the proposer ran with, such as a model, a frame interval and size, or the hints it was given. Free-form

createdAt.description: UTC instant at which the document was made (ISO 8601)

steps.description: Suggested steps. A step left out has no suggestion. A stepId may appear more than once when the proposer thinks the step happened more than once. Repeats of a stepId are occurrences ordered by start: for a step with replicates they fill its instances in order, and occurrences beyond the step's instance count (one for a step without replicates) are extra intervals

seconds.$comment: A time:Instant expressed as a time:Duration from the video's first frame with time:unitType time:unitSecond

stepSuggestion.$comment: start and end are not compared with each other or with video.durationSeconds here; draft-07 cannot express it, so consumers check them

stepId.description: The step's id as authored in the program

present.description: true: the proposer thinks the step happened, between start and end; false: it thinks the step did not happen, and start and end are omitted

start.description: Proposed time:hasBeginning, seconds of the video's media timeline (0 is its first frame). Required when present is true, forbidden when false

end.description: Proposed time:hasEnd, seconds of the video's media timeline (0 is its first frame). Required when present is true, forbidden when false

confidence.description: The proposer's confidence in this suggestion, from 0 (none) to 1 (certain). Optional: a proposer without a confidence omits it
